name: First thing in the morning?
caption: A tiny script that reads six tabs so you don't have to. The free version is in the lab, link in bio.

media.alt: Slide 1 of 4. Writing a daily morning digest script so you don't have to check six different tabs before 9 AM. First thing in the morning?
